images.title: Sixths that fill a third
images.purpose: Show that 2 pieces of 1/6 are exactly as long as 1/3 of the same whole, because 6 sixths share out over 3 thirds.
images.composition: Two flat bands of the same length, one above the other, with one third lifted out on the right and matched against two sixths.
images.exact_structure: Left area: upper band cut into 3 equal parts, all plain; lower band exactly the same length, left edges lined up, cut into 6 equal parts, all plain. Right area, with wide white space: one piece of the upper band's size filled teal #0072B2, and directly under it 2 pieces of the lower band's size filled amber #E69F00, laid end to end; the 2 amber pieces end exactly where the teal piece ends. Exactly 2 bands, 1 teal piece, 2 amber pieces.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered

flowers, petals or string drawn on the bands, or pieces of different sizes than their band parts
images.takeaway: 2 pieces of 1/6 fill the length of 1/3.
images.description: A band in thirds and a band in sixths of the same length; on the right one teal third is matched with two amber sixths that end at the same place.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the teal third and say how many amber sixths sit under it.

image_decisions.why: Matching sixths against a third is a picture idea; one image of the bands and the matched pieces carries it.
